name: First Note
hint: Tap a tile. Its ring travels where the arrow points.

name: Gaps
hint: Rings leap over empty space. Hover a tile to see where it reaches.

name: Split
hint: Split tiles send the ring both ways.

name: Branches
hint: Almost every tile nearly works. Find the one that does.

name: Delay
hint: Hourglass tiles wait an extra beat.

name: Hush
hint: Striped tiles stay silent until their second hit.

name: Chorus
hint: Splits, delays and silence, all together.
rows: S| S- S- Dv S- S-

name: Turn
hint: Tap the gold ↻ to rotate a tile before you play.

name: Tuning
hint: Tune every dial, then strike once.
